summary: Practise power, cooling, maintenance and incident routines for critical facilities. Review the data-centre operations course outline.
lede: Data-centre facilities operations and availability management covers routines for keeping power, cooling and maintenance aligned with service needs. It is for facilities engineers, critical-environment technicians and infrastructure operations professionals who support facility availability, and builds skills in reviewing power and cooling conditions, prioritising maintenance and escalating incidents. Participants also calculate PUE from case data and draft controlled operating procedures and availability improvement plans for adaptation to their facility.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who make or support daily decisions about data-centre facility availability, critical power and cooling, maintenance windows and operational response.
prerequisites: Prior exposure to data-centre facilities, critical environments or IT infrastructure operations is recommended. You should be familiar with basic electrical and cooling-system terminology; no programming is required. Practical exercises use supplied case records and spreadsheet calculations. Certification mapping, exam access and certification delivery arrangements require confirmation before promotion as preparation for a named certification.
